name: D-8-4 Technology Startup visa (OASIS)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 60 or more points on the OASIS assessment, combining education, intellectual property, prior investment secured, relevant Korea experience, and Korean-language ability -- no minimum capital investment is required, unlike the D-8-1 corporate-investment track's KRW 100 million floor.
requirements.fix_path: Increase points via a higher degree, registered IP, completing the OASIS incubation program (worth 30 points), or documented Korea-relevant experience.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires establishing a Korean corporation to house the startup; the visa is granted to found and run this company, not for employment elsewhere.
requirements.fix_path: Register a Korean corporation for the startup venture.

evidence_required.document: OASIS points-assessment form and supporting credential documentation
Korean corporate registration for the startup
Intellectual property registration or equivalent technology-capability evidence, where claimed for points

sources.title: HiKorea -- Korea Immigration Service's official portal for visa categories, ARC, and stay procedures

notes: STRUCTURAL FINDING, distinguishing this route sharply from kr_d8_corporate_investment: D-8-4 (OASIS, Overall Assistance for Startup Immigration System) requires zero capital investment, substituting a 60+ point technology/credential assessment for the D-8-1 track's flat KRW 100 million capital floor -- a genuinely different qualifying logic from the same broader D-8 visa family, not a scaled-down version of the investment track. This mirrors the UK Global Talent / Turkey employer-side-ratio pattern of adversarial structural variation documented in the project brief: two routes sharing a visa-code family but requiring fundamentally different things from the applicant. F-5-24 is a dedicated permanent-residence sub-track specifically for D-8-4 holders (3+ years on D-8-4, KRW 300 million or more in investment attracted, 2+ Korean full-time employees for 6+ months) -- faster and structurally different from the general F-5-1 5-year/2x-GNI track, which is why pr_after_months here (36) differs from most other Korea work routes in this build (60). OASIS completion itself is worth 30 of the 60 required points, making it a strongly recommended (though not strictly mandatory) on-ramp for first-time applicants rather than a separate formal requirement -- not modeled as its own requirement here since it is one of several ways to reach the point threshold, not a gate.
